# awscc_accessanalyzer_archive_rule (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::AccessAnalyzer::ArchiveRule



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `analyzer_name` (String) The name of the analyzer for the archive rule.
- `arn` (String) The ARN of the archive rule.
- `created_at` (String) The time at which the archive rule was created.
- `filter` (Attributes Map) The criteria for the archive rule. A map of filter criteria property names to their criterion values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `rule_name` (String) The name of the archive rule.
- `updated_at` (String) The time at which the archive rule was last updated.
